suggestions.title: Display empty state for habits list
suggestions.what: Show a 'No habits yet! Tap '+' to add your first habit.' message when the habit list is empty.
suggestions.why: Guides new users, prevents blank screens, and encourages initial engagement with the habit tracking feature.
suggestions.ui_impact: A centered text message and an illustrative icon will appear in the `HabitChecklistView` when no habits have been added.

suggestions.title: Display empty state for task lists
suggestions.what: Show a 'No tasks added yet. Use the field below to add one.' message when the `tasks` array is empty.
suggestions.why: Provides clear guidance in Work and Generic sections, preventing confusion and prompting user action.
suggestions.ui_impact: A centered text message and an icon will appear in the `TaskListView` when no tasks are present.

suggestions.title: Display empty state for grocery list
suggestions.what: Show a 'Your list is empty! Add an item below.' message when the `items` array is empty.
suggestions.why: Informs users when there's no content and clearly prompts them to add items, improving usability.
suggestions.ui_impact: A centered text message and an icon (e.g., 'cart.fill') will appear in the scroll view area when the grocery list is empty.

suggestions.title: Display empty state for prayers list
suggestions.what: Show a 'No prayers added yet. Tap '+' to add one.' message when the `prayers` array is empty.
suggestions.why: Guides users to add their spiritual practices, avoiding a blank screen and making the feature more approachable.
suggestions.ui_impact: A centered text message and an icon (e.g., 'sparkles') will appear in the scroll view area when no prayers are listed.

suggestions.title: Enhance empty state for gym workout days
suggestions.what: When `store.days` is empty, replace the 'Select a workout day above' message with a prominent call to action to add the first workout day.
suggestions.why: Directly guides new users to set up their gym tracking, significantly reducing initial friction and improving onboarding.
suggestions.ui_impact: A larger, more central message like 'No workout days yet! Tap the '+' button to add your first workout plan.' will appear, possibly with an animated pointer to the plus button.

suggestions.title: Add placeholder text to journal editor
suggestions.what: Display 'What's on your mind today?' as a placeholder in the `JournalEditorView` when `entryText` is empty.
suggestions.why: Encourages users to start writing and makes the blank editor less intimidating, improving the journaling experience.
suggestions.ui_impact: A light gray placeholder text will be visible in the text editor when no content has been entered.

suggestions.title: Display empty state for 'Thought of Day'
suggestions.what: Show a default positive message or a prompt to add a thought if `vm.thoughtOfDay` is empty.
suggestions.why: Prevents a large blank space on the home dashboard and maintains a positive, engaging tone even without user input.
suggestions.ui_impact: A default message like 'Embrace the day!' or 'Tap to add your daily thought' will appear instead of a blank space.

suggestions.title: Display error state for weather data
suggestions.what: Show a 'Weather unavailable' message with an optional retry button if weather data fetching fails or returns an error.
suggestions.why: Informs the user about data issues and provides a way to refresh, preventing a blank or incomplete weather display and improving reliability.
suggestions.ui_impact: A small text message 'Weather unavailable. Tap to retry.' will appear below the greeting instead of temperature/city/condition, with a tappable area to trigger a refresh.
suggestions.backend_impact: HomeViewModel needs to expose an error state and a retry mechanism.

suggestions.title: Add accessibility for habit swipe-to-delete
suggestions.what: Implement `accessibilityActions` for the `HabitRow` to allow VoiceOver users to delete habits without relying on the swipe gesture.
suggestions.why: Ensures users with visual impairments or motor difficulties can easily manage their habits, making the app more inclusive.
suggestions.ui_impact: No visual change, but VoiceOver users will hear 'Delete' as an available action when a habit row is selected, accessible via rotor actions.

suggestions.title: Add haptic feedback to main home buttons
suggestions.what: Implement light haptic feedback when the Checklist, Control Centre, and Gallery buttons are tapped.
suggestions.why: Enhances the interactive experience and provides satisfying tactile confirmation for primary navigation actions on the home screen.
suggestions.ui_impact: A subtle vibration will occur when any of the three main circular buttons at the bottom of `HomeView` are pressed.

suggestions.title: Make scratch card hint accessible
suggestions.what: Add `accessibilityElement(children: .ignore)` to the Canvas and an `accessibilityLabel` to `ScratchCardView` for the 'Scratch to reveal' hint.
suggestions.why: VoiceOver users will hear the instruction to scratch the card, improving usability for visually impaired users.
suggestions.ui_impact: No visual change; VoiceOver will announce the hint when the card is focused.

suggestions.title: Standardize Work section notes empty state
suggestions.what: Replace the `Text("Start typing...")` placeholder in `WorkSectionView`'s `workNotes` with the reusable `EmptyNotesView` component.
suggestions.why: Provides a consistent and more visually engaging empty state across all note sections, reducing cognitive load.
suggestions.ui_impact: When the 'Work' section's notes tab is empty, a dedicated 'No notes yet' message with an icon will appear.

suggestions.title: Add haptic feedback to habit toggles
suggestions.what: Implement `UIImpactFeedbackGenerator(style: .light)` for `HabitRow`'s `onTap` action to confirm habit completion/uncompletion.
suggestions.why: Provides immediate tactile feedback, enhancing the perceived responsiveness and satisfaction of interacting with habits.
suggestions.ui_impact: Users will feel a light tap when they toggle a habit in the checklist.

suggestions.title: Enhance Generic Checklist Empty State
suggestions.what: Update `TaskListView`'s empty state to use the section's accent color for the icon and a more prominent message.
suggestions.why: Improves visual consistency and makes the empty state more inviting and less stark, encouraging user engagement.
suggestions.ui_impact: The empty checklist icon and text will appear more vibrant and integrated with the section's theme.

suggestions.title: Show loading indicator for journal photos
suggestions.what: Display a `ProgressView` in `JournalEditorView` while a photo is being loaded from `PhotosPickerItem`.
suggestions.why: Provides immediate visual feedback to the user that the app is processing their selection, improving perceived performance.
suggestions.ui_impact: A small loading spinner will appear in the image area while a photo is being loaded.

suggestions.title: Enhance accessibility for interactive elements
suggestions.what: Add dynamic `accessibilityLabel` to `PillButton` and an `accessibilityAction` to `ScratchCardView` for VoiceOver.
suggestions.why: Ensures users with visual impairments can understand the purpose of these interactive elements and use the scratch card.
suggestions.ui_impact: No visual change, but VoiceOver will announce button states and provide an alternative reveal action.
